title: Signed envelope base
description: Fields every wire object carries (plan: 'Wire contracts'). subject_digest = sha256 of the RFC 8785 canonical bytes of the object with signature/subject_digest removed. signature (E1) is a base64 Ed25519 signature over the DSSE Pre-Authentication Encoding of that same canonical subject (see wire/signing.py); E0 treated it as opaque. Receipt-chain linkage (prev_digest, E1) is NOT a base field: it lives only on the chain-bearing receipt types (StageReceipt, ToolReceipt) because only those types can say where in a chain they sit -- on the base it would be optional everywhere, unable to distinguish 'this type never chains' from 'this is the chain's first (genesis) element'. See wire/chain.py:verify_chain.

type.description: wire object type name, e.g. StageReceipt

issuer.description: the identity that issued this object; a principal, never a platform name

nonce.description: single-use per (run_id, nonce); consumed atomically by the host before dispatch (E3)

key_id.description: identifies the signing key; resolved to a trust root by an injected TrustStore (E1), never from this payload

signature.description: base64 Ed25519 signature over the DSSE PAE of the canonical subject (E1); verified only when a TrustStore is supplied to wire.verify.verify
